release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.1.7

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice. Tesseract and Labels are inside the program folder.

Update: The installer waits until LockStepPDF has left the process list, then retries files that are still in use. If the copy still fails, it does not reopen the program. Close every LockStepPDF window, including any still listed in Task Manager, before you install this one. The check at launch tries again for about a minute when the list cannot be reached.

Tools: The pop-out takes the whole tool, not only the button row. Put that window on another screen. The preview widens into the space the tool leaves. Dock, or closing the window, puts the same form back.
